subject.label: sport
subject._note: School of Sport container context: a single academic school spanning sport & exercise science, sport coaching and physical education, sport management and development, sport therapy and rehabilitation, and strength & conditioning. There is no QAA benchmark for sport in this repo, so prose is grounded in sport & exercise science / sport domain knowledge rather than a benchmark digest.

_note: School of Sport container context pack for understanding-learning-assessment-feedback-introductory. Frames the academic-practice skill for the school as a whole, drawing worked examples from across its subjects and varying the subject lesson to lesson (L01 sport & exercise science, L02 sport coaching, L03 sport management and development, L04 sport therapy and rehabilitation, L05 strength & conditioning).
